messages:
emma: Quick announcement: shipping redwood-sdk v1.1 docs refresh and a small CLI change. No hard break for most users but please read the migration notes.

rafael: What changed in the CLI?

emma: CLI subcommand rename: `rw-cli auth` -> `rw auth`. Old command will print a deprecation warning for two releases.

priya: Any runtime or API surface changes that could surprise integrators?

emma: Mostly docs and examples tidy-up + one API tweak: the embeddings helper now returns normalized vectors by default (previously raw). We document how to get raw vectors with `client.embeddings(..., normalize=False)`.

releasebot: release published: redwood-sdk v1.1.0 (docs + minor API) https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/1.1.0 :rocket:

docs-bot: Docs site updated: /sdk/ -> added "v1.1 notes" page and updated CLI guide. CDN invalidation queued at 11:00 UTC.

rafael: We should call out env var deprecations if any.

emma: Good catch. We're deprecating the old RW_LEGACY_MODE env var in favor of RW_COMPAT_MODE. For now both are supported; logs will show a deprecation message when RW_LEGACY_MODE is used. Timeline: warn now, remove in ~120 days.

priya: I'll draft a short KB with the common migration steps and two example diffs (embeddings and CLI). Can we get a one-paragraph blurb for customer comms?

emma: Sure: "redwood-sdk v1.1 improves embedding stability and tidies CLI commands. No urgent action required for most users; follow the one-line checklist in the migration page if you use the CLI or embeddings helpers." Put that in the KB.

rafael: I'll add a quick automated test to ensure `rw auth` fallback remains in place for the deprecation window.

docs-bot: added /sdk/migration/v1.1 checklist and examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/427

emma: Action items: @priya publish KB + canned responses; @rafael add fallback test; docs will monitor support tickets for the next 2 weeks. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
